title: trichiogramme marginata

The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Trichiogramme marginata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, analgesic, and antimicrobial properties.
